dataset: Surface emittance (emissivity) of bare pipe, jacketing, coverings and insulation surfaces: sourced values for an ASTM C680 / NAIMA 3E Plus style heat-loss and condensation calculator

conventions.unverified: The literal string 'unverified' (and each item in an 'unverified' list) means no fetched source stated the value. Nothing was guessed, averaged, interpolated or filled from memory.
conventions.src: Every value carries 'src', a list of ids in the top-level 'sources' array, and a verbatim 'quote'.
conventions.quotes: Quotes are verbatim from pdftotext output or page text. Line breaks were joined; nothing else changed. For tables, the label cell and value cell are joined with ' | '. Two tables are images with no text layer: the 3E Plus v4.1 Jacket Material and Base Metals screenshots (E1) and the Armacell Figure 5 table (E15). Their rows were transcribed by eye from images extracted with pdfimages, and each such quote says so in 'quote_note'.
conventions.value_fields: 'value' is the number as printed. A printed range uses 'value_min'/'value_max' instead. 'value_as_printed' keeps the source's exact text, e.g. '.8' or '0.1–0.2'.
conventions.kind: 'listed_value' = a value from a reference list or table. 'calculation_assumption' = a value a publisher says it put into its own thickness or heat-loss tables (an input, not a measurement). 'measured_test_method' = a product value reported against a named test method.
conventions.three_e_plus_value: Each surface records what the 3E Plus v4.1 built-in list uses (E1), for parity with 3E Plus. This only points to a sourced value; no default was chosen or invented.
conventions.test_methods: ASTM C1371 (portable emissometer) gives total hemispherical emittance, 'with a precision of better than ±0.02 units' (E20). ASTM E408, used by Lamtec, covers 'two comparative methods for determination of total normal emittance' (E20 scope). The two are not the same quantity. Solar reflectance (ASTM C1549) is a different property and is not used as emittance anywhere in this file.
conventions.temperature_and_condition: Emittance changes with surface condition and temperature. The ASHRAE table (E2) is labelled 'Emittance (~80 °F)'. ROCKWOOL (E14) warns: 'the emissivity of a material varies with temperature and surface finishes'. ASTM C680 lists 'jacket emittance' among the inputs that must be chosen for each case and does not publish values (E21).
conventions.emissivity_vs_emittance: Sources say 'emittance' (US) or 'emissivity' (EU). Values are recorded as printed, under whichever word the source uses.

method: PDFs were downloaded with curl into /tmp/claude-1000/research-emit/ and read with pdftotext (raw and -layout). Image-only tables were extracted with pdfimages and read visually. insulation.org pages were read through the WordPress REST API. WBDG's calculator pages (wbdg.org/files/calculators/*.html) now serve an empty single-page-app shell, and the Wayback Machine blocked automated requests, so the NIA-hosted copies of the same calculators were used. armacell.com HTML pages sit behind a Cloudflare challenge (HTTP 403), but direct /sites/default/files/ PDF links downloaded fine. No Chrome browser was connected, so no page was read through a browser.
